   - bound form: `[disableTooltip]="expr"` → `[hideHint]="expr"`
   - plain attribute form: `disableTooltip` (no value) → `hideHint`
   Tags can span multiple lines — look carefully, the attribute may be on its own line.

Rename `.disableTooltip()` → `.hideHint()` ONLY in these cases. If the receiver is a `viewChild(CardComponent)` or a template-ref variable (`#someName`) declared on an `<app-card>` or `<app-pill-legacy>` element, do NOT rename it — leave `.disableTooltip()` as-is. Example of a trap seen already: `<app-card #summary .../>` followed by `summary.disableTooltip()` in a template — `summary` is a CardComponent reference here, so that call must stay unchanged.
C. `setInput("disableTooltip", ...)` calls — only rename the string to `"hideHint"` if the target component (from `createComponent(...)`) is PillComponent/FancyPillComponent/StatusPillComponent. Leave it alone for CardComponent/PillLegacyComponent. If the receiver is a `viewChild(CardComponent)` or a template-ref variable (`#someName`) declared on an `<app-card>` or `<app-pill-legacy>` element, do NOT rename it — leave `.disableTooltip()` as-is.
